achievements.name: Welcome to the City of the Dead
achievements.description: Story: reach the R.P.D. police station.

achievements.name: Path to the Goddess
achievements.description: Story: solve the Goddess Statue puzzle in the Main Hall.

achievements.name: Never-Ending Rain
achievements.description: Story: escape the police station.

achievements.name: Hack Complete
achievements.description: Story: complete Ada's playable section (Leon's campaign).

achievements.name: Hide and Seek
achievements.description: Story: complete Sherry's playable section (Claire's campaign).

achievements.name: A Great Need for a Shower
achievements.description: Story: escape the sewers.

achievements.name: A Hero Emerges
achievements.description: Complete Leon's story.

achievements.name: A Heroine Emerges
achievements.description: Complete Claire's story.

achievements.name: Broken Umbrella
achievements.description: See the true ending by finishing a "2nd run" scenario with either character.

achievements.name: The Basics of Survival
achievements.description: Combine two items together.

achievements.name: Hip to Add Squares
achievements.description: Increase your inventory slots.

achievements.name: Customizer
achievements.description: Customize a weapon.

achievements.name: Don't Need No Stinkin' Gun
achievements.description: Defeat an enemy with a knife.

achievements.name: Eat This!
achievements.description: Counterattack with a sub-weapon.

achievements.name: That'll Hold 'Em
achievements.description: Use Wooden Boards to board up a window.

achievements.name: Vermin Extermination
achievements.description: Destroy a Mr. Raccoon.

achievements.name: A Vault-like Mind
achievements.description: Open a portable safe.

achievements.name: First Break-In
achievements.description: Open a dial safe.

achievements.name: Bon Appétit
achievements.description: Shoot the grenade you fed to an enemy.

achievements.name: Zombie Roundup
achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies at once with a sub-weapon.

achievements.name: Like Skeet Shooting
achievements.description: Shoot a zombie dog or a licker out of the air.

achievements.name: Keep Their Heads Ringin'
achievements.description: Paralyze a licker's sense of hearing.

achievements.name: Hats Off!
achievements.description: Shoot Tyrant's hat off his head.

achievements.name: Gotcha!
achievements.description: Defeat the second boss encounter against G by hitting it with the shipping-yard crane the first time it is in reach.

achievements.name: Treasure Hunter
achievements.description: Using the photo hints, find 2 hidden items.

achievements.name: A Waist of Space
achievements.description: Expand inventory slots to max.

achievements.name: One Slick Super-spy
achievements.description: Complete Ada's section without firing her handgun - use only the EMF Visualizer.

achievements.name: Young Escapee
achievements.description: Get Sherry through her section without being caught by Chief Irons.

achievements.name: With Time to Spare
achievements.description: As Claire, defeat the final boss with 4 or more minutes left on the self-destruct timer.

achievements.name: In the Blink of an Eye
achievements.description: As Leon, defeat the final boss with 5 or more minutes left on the self-destruct timer.

achievements.name: Lore Explorer
achievements.description: Read all of the files.

achievements.name: Complete Vermin Extermination
achievements.description: Destroy all Mr. Raccoons.

achievements.name: Master of Unlocking
achievements.description: Open all of the safes and locks in the game.

achievements.name: Leon "S." Kennedy
achievements.description: Finish Leon's story with an S rank.

achievements.name: Sizzling Scarlet Hero
achievements.description: Finish Claire's story with an S rank.

achievements.name: Hardcore Rookie
achievements.description: Complete Leon's story on "Hardcore" game mode.

achievements.name: Hardcore College Student
achievements.description: Complete Claire's story on "Hardcore" game mode.

achievements.name: Frugalist
achievements.description: Complete the game without using a recovery item.

achievements.name: Minimalist
achievements.description: Clear the game without opening the item box.

achievements.name: A Small Carbon Footprint
achievements.description: Take 14000 steps or fewer in one playthrough.

achievements.name: Grim Reaper
achievements.description: Complete the bonus mode "The 4th Survivor".

achievements.name: Hell of a Sheriff
achievements.description: Complete the bonus mode "The Tofu Survivor".

achievements.name: Got 'Em
achievements.description: Destroy all Mr. Raccoons hidden in The Ghost Survivors mode.

achievements.name: Chasing Jill
achievements.description: Read a letter left behind by Jill.
